title: The Lord's Feasts: An Overview
description: The Lord gives Moses a detailed overview of the annual feasts and holy convocations that Israel is to celebrate, including the Sabbath, Passover, the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Firstfruits, the Feast of Tabernacles, and the Day of Atonement. [ref:Lev 23:1-44|Leviticus 23:1-44]
